topic: Soil types, characteristics, and importance for plant growth
key_concepts: Soil is the loose particles that make up Earth's surface.
Soil is needed by plants and animals to live and grow.
The main soil types are sandy, clay, silt, and loam.
Soil characteristics include color, texture, particle size, and ability to hold water.
Different soil types absorb and drain water differently.
